picks.headline: Engram: a sampler that circuit-bends tiny AI models and turns their hallucinations into playable sound
picks.excerpt: Thoughtful Things' Engram is a sampler billed as a 'field recorder for latent space' that circuit-bends tiny AI models, turning their broken hallucinations into playable sound.
picks.rationale: The freshest item and the most creative one: a new instrument that treats model failure as sound-design material. It is the strongest tool story in the pool, and no published card covers it.

picks.headline: ElevenLabs Studio 4.0: an agentic editor that generates music, SFX, voice and video inside one project
picks.excerpt: ElevenLabs Studio 4.0 is an agentic video editor inside ElevenCreative that generates video, image, voice, music and sound effects directly within a project.
picks.rationale: A new product release that puts music and SFX generation directly in the editing timeline, which is useful for anyone scoring content. It differs from the published ElevenMusic v2.5 and section-editing cards.

picks.headline: Why generative AI can't give audio pros the happy accident behind gated reverb
picks.excerpt: Generative AI is built to guess the most likely answer, which rules out the happy accidents that gave us gated reverb. Here is what that costs audio pros.
picks.rationale: A practitioner-level critique of how generative models work, written for engineers and producers. It is a different argument and outlet from the published Fred again.. and Brian May stance cards.

picks.headline: As WMG and BMG license Suno v6, artist reps call it 'the Wild, Wild West'
picks.excerpt: As Suno makes AI music deals with labels like WMG and BMG for its new v6 models, artist representatives for Mötley Crüe, Afroman and more react.
picks.rationale: This is the only Suno pick. Its new angle is managers and reps for named artists reacting to the label deals, which has not been covered. It is distinct from the published v6 launch (9/12), user backlash (9/18), second lawsuit (9/22) and Sharks goal-song (9/27) cards.

picks.headline: Music AI 2.0: the split between disposable synthetic content and identity-driven artist music
picks.excerpt: Music AI is splitting into two industries: transient, synthetic content and lasting, artist-driven music based on identity.
picks.rationale: A framework piece on where AI creative music is heading. It is the fifth distinct outlet and ranks ahead of the weaker fraud and Braille items in the fresh pool.
